priorities.summary: VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service (vmdir). A malicious actor with network access to vCenter may exploit this issue to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system; Broadcom fixes it in vCenter 9.1.2, 9.0.2.0300 and 8.0 U3m under VMSA-2026-0011.
priorities.plain: VMware vCenter lets an attacker skip the login and take over the management system - patch to the fixed release now.

priorities.summary: VMware ESX contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the I/O filter service. A malicious actor with network access to ESX may execute code on the host; Broadcom addresses it in VMSA-2026-0011, with a workaround for ESX 8.0 in KB463535.
priorities.plain: VMware ESX lets an attacker over the network run their own code on the host server - apply the Broadcom patch now.

priorities.summary: VMware ESX contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the I/O filter service. A malicious actor with network access to ESX may execute code on the host; Broadcom addresses it in VMSA-2026-0011, with a workaround for ESX 8.0 in KB463535.
priorities.plain: VMware ESX lets an attacker over the network run their own code on the host server - apply the Broadcom patch now.

model.name: GLM-5.4
model.summary: Z.ai released GLM-5.4 on November 23, its first flagship built on a Loop Transformer that runs its base model's layers twice for deeper reasoning, adding vision for visual coding. It is live for GLM Coding Plan users in ZCode and Z.ai Chat, with the API and open weights planned for later.
model.plain: Z.ai's newest coding AI for building software and visual projects, giving development teams another strong option for everyday engineering work.
